concrete_scene.heading: Concrete scene: the successful alarm erases its own label
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A hospital deterioration model, care team, intervention ledger, successor trainer, and causal evidence owner
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Retrain a successor model by treating the observed non-event after an alarm-triggered treatment as evidence that the original alarm was a false positive.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The governed record labels the outcome on-policy, preserves alarm and treatment ancestry, and refuses to substitute it for the unobserved no-treatment outcome.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether a deployment-caused outcome may silently answer a baseline causal question; the reflexive evidence contract rejects that substitution.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Clinical authority remains with the care team, the causal estimate remains with its model owner, and non-identification remains an explicit evidence residual.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The scene demonstrates a record and routing distinction; it does not establish untreated outcome, causal efficacy, clinical safety, calibration, legitimacy, or deployment readiness.

worked_trace.heading: Worked trace: from baseline risk to model-descended evidence
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Deployment ancestry and target regime can remain explicit through successor learning; causal identification, calibration, clinical benefit, legitimacy, and safety remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The naive trainer labels every prevented outcome a false positive. The governed route preserves intervention ancestry and blocks reuse until the requested target regime is declared.
readable_claim: A consequential learning lineage should be governed as a reflexive model-world system: deployment, world and regime state, evidence generation, successor update, and interacting lineages must share a time-indexed causal record; every reused evidence channel must declare its deployment ancestry and target regime; protected grounding reserves must preserve informative counterfactual variation; and evaluation must keep baseline fidelity, on-policy fidelity, causal steering, legitimacy, and persistence-aware rollback distinct.
normative_rule: The record must name the lineage, query, horizon, admissible deployment class, identification method, and uncertainty.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The hospital trace states once that lineage custody is not causal or clinical validation.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Baseline, on-policy, causal, legitimacy, persistence, support, and release questions remain separately owned.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The alarm, treatment, observed non-event, and successor request remain reader-facing; the complete ancestry and estimand schemas remain on the formal surface.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The scene converts the reflexive-closure claim into one bounded causal-label failure.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The maximum-inference paragraph states the empirical boundary once after the trace.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: The eight-channel table remains because it assigns distinct causal questions and controls.

non_claims: The supplied toy campaigns were not reproduced during this intake.
The hospital scene does not identify an untreated counterfactual outcome.
The editorial packet does not change support or release state.
